per_candidate.id: s2:How Reliable are Rotation Period Determinations from TESS Data?
s2:Long-term Periodicities in Kepler Photometry of Open Cluster NGC 6811

rationale: None of the candidate papers directly investigate the specific mechanism behind the discrepancies in the magnetic activity versus rotation period relationship or the role of the interface-type dynamo and SDR. They are related to stellar rotation and magnetic activity but do not address the question directly.
